say:4:1411432001:3.text: Long, long ago, for various reasons, there was a terrible war.
say:4:1411432001:3.source_cn: 很久以前，因为种种原因，有一场很惨烈的战争。

say:5:1411432002:0.text: For other various reasons, Dura led the humans and Celestials against the Hypogeans.
say:5:1411432002:0.source_cn: 总而言之，因为种种原因，艾雅率领人类与半神们，与恶魔作战。

choice_prompt:6:1411432002.text: For other various reasons, Dura led the humans and Celestials against the Hypogeans.
choice_prompt:6:1411432002.source_cn: 总而言之，因为种种原因，艾雅率领人类与半神们，与恶魔作战。

say:7:1411432003:0.text: The brutality of this war was unparalleled. Countless powerful Hypogeans appeared in the world.
say:7:1411432003:0.source_cn: 这场战斗的惨烈程度前所未有，无数强大的恶魔涌现于世间。

say:8:1411432004:0.text: Among them was a famous Hypogean who loved destruction. Some people called her the Tectonic Terror or the Ashen Sunder. Many also called her the Mad Explosion Maniac, but her real name was <style="highlight">Kulusta</style>.
say:8:1411432004:0.source_cn: 其中，“震颤的火山”“撕裂陆地的火药”“疯癫的爆炸狂”...

choice_prompt:9:1411432004.text: Among them was a famous Hypogean who loved destruction. Some people called her the Tectonic Terror or the Ashen Sunder. Many also called her the Mad Explosion Maniac, but her real name was <style="highlight">Kulusta</style>.
choice_prompt:9:1411432004.source_cn: 其中，“震颤的火山”“撕裂陆地的火药”“疯癫的爆炸狂”<style=highlight>库露丝塔</style>极为有名。

say:10:1411432005:0.text: Madness ran in her blood. A tempest of fury always seconds from eruption. One wrong word, one stray glance, and the world would shatter in her wake.
say:10:1411432005:0.source_cn: 她天性狂躁，疯狂易怒，而这份怒火随时随地都会点燃，形成...

say:11:1411432006:0.text: Her blasts cared nothing for targets—not for timing, not for bystanders, not for sense. She detonated when she pleased and let the world deal with the aftermath.
say:11:1411432006:0.source_cn: 而她的爆炸敌我不分，也同样不分场合——事实上，她无视一切。

say:12:1411432007:0.text: She was perpetually furious, causing explosions and destruction without end.
say:12:1411432007:0.source_cn: 她只是永恒地暴怒，疯狂地爆炸，带来无穷无尽的毁灭。

say:13:1411432008:0.text: Until one day, her anger and madness reached an unprecedented level.
say:13:1411432008:0.source_cn: 直到有一天，她的愤怒与疯狂达到了前所未有的程度——

say:16:1411432009:0.text: Hahahahaha! This time, the explosion will be glorious!
say:16:1411432009:0.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈哈，这次，我要带给你们完美的轰炸！

say:17:1411432010:0.text: This bomb's so massive it won't just sink the continent! It'll crack the world like an egg! Hahahahaha!
say:17:1411432010:0.source_cn: 这个超级大炸弹，能够击沉整片大陆，不，整个世界！

say:19:1411432011:0.text: Her madness surged beyond reason—and the bomb swelled with it, mirroring her spiral into chaos.
say:19:1411432011:0.source_cn: 她膨胀到了极致，而那个炸弹也随着她激荡的情感膨胀到了极致。

say:20:1411432012:0.text: In that moment, a Celestial descended. His wings were ablaze with radiance, and a colossal sword gleamed in his grasp.
say:20:1411432012:0.source_cn: 而此时，一位有着耀眼羽翼，手持巨剑的半神出现了。

say:21:1411432013:0.text: He had once reigned supreme over countless battlefields, delivering triumphant glory to legions of warriors.
say:21:1411432013:0.source_cn: 他曾经主宰无数战场，为千军带来辉煌的胜利。

say:22:1411432014:0.text: His massive sword knew no equal, having cleaved through the bodies of numerous Hypogeans.
say:22:1411432014:0.source_cn: 他的巨剑无坚不摧，曾经斩断最为可怖的恶魔之身。

say:23:1411432015:0.text: He was known as the <style="highlight">Dawnblade</style>, and time and again, his radiant power rose up to counter Kulusta's reign of terror.

say:24:1411432016:0.text: That time, once again, he stepped forward and stood in the path of this horrible Hypogean.
say:24:1411432016:0.source_cn: 而这次，他再次挺身而出，挡在了凶暴的恶魔面前。

say:26:1411432017:2.text: Oh, you again? You flappy little maggot! And just in time too! Now I get to blow you up along with this dumb world! Yay! Hahahahaha!
say:26:1411432017:2.source_cn: 又是你！你这个长翅膀的蛆虫，来得正好，你就跟这个世界一...

say:28:1411432018:0.text: Your corruption ends now. You, wretched fiend, shall be cast into oblivion.
say:28:1411432018:0.source_cn: 只要有我在，你就无法得逞，肮脏的恶魔啊，会毁灭的只有你。

say:29:1411432019:0.text: I shall strike you down here and deliver victory unto this world!
say:29:1411432019:0.source_cn: 而我将会击败你，为这个世界带来辉煌的胜利！

say:30:1411432020:0.text: Wonderful! Your stupid little words just made me so much angrier! Say hello to the biggest, baddest bomb you've ever seen!
say:30:1411432020:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，棒极了，你的话让我的怒火更加燃烧，尝尝吧，这...

say:32:1411432021:1.text: Kulusta triggered the bomb, and in the split second before detonation, the Celestial swung his colossal sword through the air.
say:32:1411432021:1.source_cn: 库露丝塔引发了炸弹，而就在炸弹爆炸的前夕，那位半神挥下...

say:33:1411432022:2.text: The massive sword erupted in celestial brilliance, its sacred light engulfing both the bomb and Kulusta in a single radiant embrace...
say:33:1411432022:2.source_cn: 从天而降的巨剑带来辉煌的光芒，将炸弹与库露丝塔同时笼罩...

say:34:1411432023:2.text: No one truly witnessed what unfolded. All that was known was that after the brilliant light dimmed, Kulusta remained, slumped in the same spot, on the verge of death.
say:34:1411432023:2.source_cn: 具体的情形无人看清，只知道光芒消逝后，留在原地的库露丝...

say:35:1411432024:1.text: And in that moment, Dura manifested, and her divine will sealed the Hypogean away.
say:35:1411432024:1.source_cn: 于是，艾雅施展力量，将她封印其中。

say:37:1411432025:1.text: If that Celestial had not stopped Kulusta, the consequences would have been devastating.
say:37:1411432025:1.source_cn: 如果没有那位半神，库露丝塔的愤怒下，就不知道会造成怎样...

say:38:1411432026:1.text: And that's how the story ends. What did you think of the play?
say:38:1411432026:1.source_cn: 故事到此结束，由我和伊莱亚扮演的戏剧，诸位感想如何呢。

choice_prompt:39:1411432026.text: And that's how the story ends. What did you think of the play?
choice_prompt:39:1411432026.source_cn: 故事到此结束，由我和伊莱亚扮演的戏剧，诸位感想如何呢。

say:40:1411432027:1.text: See, Lailah. I knew Merlin's tastes hadn't changed.
say:40:1411432027:1.source_cn: 梅林的品位还是一如既往呢，莱拉。
say:40:1411432027:1.male: See, Lailah. I knew Merlin's tastes hadn't changed.
say:40:1411432027:1.female: See, Lailah. I knew Merlin's tastes hadn't changed.

say:41:1411432028:1.text: If everyone were as easy to please as him, life would be easy.
say:41:1411432028:1.source_cn: 如果全世界的观众都像<male>他</male><fe...
say:41:1411432028:1.male: If everyone were as easy to please as him, life would be easy.
say:41:1411432028:1.female: If everyone were as easy to please as her, life would be easy.

say:43:1411432031:1.text: Didn't Kulu say that she just bought her clothes recently? Why does she look the same in your play?
say:43:1411432031:1.source_cn: 但，那个库露露不是说过，她的衣服是自己买的，为什么过去...

say:44:1411432032:1.text: To tell you the truth, in the past, she would have never thought of things like hairstyle and clothing.
say:44:1411432032:1.source_cn: 事实上，她的发型和过去也不一样，过去的她不会考虑发型、...

say:45:1411432033:1.text: Yes, in the past, she was more like an active bomb. And yes, we know—her hairstyle and outfit didn't exist yet. But we figured recycling the current look would help you keep up. You're welcome.
say:45:1411432033:1.source_cn: 事实上，过去的她就像是一个行动的炸弹，而现在的造型，我...

say:48:1411432036:1.text: He sounded so cool and awesome! I mean, he had wings of light and a huge sword! Sounds like a hero of legends!
say:48:1411432036:1.source_cn: 听起来好帅气，有着羽翼，拿着圣剑，一次次为众人带来胜利！

say:49:1411432037:1.text: He was one of the few Celestials who ever gained a personal following among the people. Due to leading troops into countless battles, he was also revered by the soldiers of the realm.
say:49:1411432037:1.source_cn: 他是少数在民间甚至获得个人信仰的半神之一，由于多次率军...

say:50:1411432038:1.text: After the Divine War, he became a revered symbol for many knightly orders. Strangely enough, over time, that image shifted—he became more of a symbol of wealth than valor.
say:50:1411432038:1.source_cn: 此后，他一度成为了许多骑士团的信仰——但不知为何，在之...

say:52:1411432039:1.text: Yes, well, don't mind him. After the war, most Celestials returned to their duties.
say:52:1411432039:1.source_cn: 咳咳，半神只要活到战后，就不会有什么大的改变，不用管他了。

say:53:1411432040:1.text: The real question we have to ask is if Kulu is really Kulusta.
say:53:1411432040:1.source_cn: 现在的问题在于库露露，她真的是库露丝塔吗？

say:54:1411432041:1.text: Yes, perhaps it's indistinguishable to others, but even if Kulu's magical aura is weak, her energies match those of Kulusta's from the past.
say:54:1411432041:1.source_cn: 是的，或许外人无法分辨，库露露的气息太过微弱，但确实与...

say:55:1411432042:1.text: But the Kulu who stands before us now isn't the same person she once was.
say:55:1411432042:1.source_cn: 但是，现在自称库露露的她，并非过去的她。

say:60:1411432044:1.text: I get what you're thinking, Merlin. If everyone loses their memory, it might make you kind of normal.
say:60:1411432044:1.source_cn: 我懂得你的担忧，梅林，失忆这个概念一旦出现太多次，会让...
say:60:1411432044:1.male: I get what you're thinking, Merlin. If everyone loses their memory, it might make you kind of normal.
say:60:1411432044:1.female: I get what you're thinking, Merlin. If everyone loses their memory, it might make you kind of normal.

say:61:1411432045:1.text: But her situation is different from yours. She lost her memories during her evil period.
say:61:1411432045:1.source_cn: 不用担心，梅林，那个恶魔的确没有凶暴时期的记忆，但她的...
say:61:1411432045:1.male: But her situation is different from yours. She lost her memories during her evil period.
say:61:1411432045:1.female: But her situation is different from yours. She lost her memories during her evil period.

say:62:1411432046:1.text: Let's try to explain it in simpler terms, Lailah.
say:62:1411432046:1.source_cn: 让我们用更简单的方式来讲述她所面临的情况吧，莱拉。

say:63:1411432047:0.text: Yes, no one is better suited to tell this story than us.
say:63:1411432047:0.source_cn: 是的，没有人比我们更适合来讲述了，伊莱亚。

say:65:1411432029:1.text: Don't be so picky, Merlin. Focus on the drama. Not on the details.
say:65:1411432029:1.source_cn: 真是挑剔啊，梅林，戏剧的重点在于情节。
say:65:1411432029:1.male: Don't be so picky, Merlin. Focus on the drama. Not on the details.
say:65:1411432029:1.female: Don't be so picky, Merlin. Focus on the drama. Not on the details.

say:66:1411432030:1.text: Yes, we gave you the gist of it. Don't ask for too much.
say:66:1411432030:1.source_cn: 我们已经为你提供了氛围和扮相，梅林，要求不要太高。
say:66:1411432030:1.male: Yes, we gave you the gist of it. Don't ask for too much.
say:66:1411432030:1.female: Yes, we gave you the gist of it. Don't ask for too much.

choice:39:1:2.female: Some parts were better than others.
